verdict.rationale: Authy documents that codes can be used without internet access on the phone (authy-docs-7), so offline generation is covered. However, the evidence shows Authy is built around a phone-number-based vendor account: devices are added via SMS, voice or existing-device approval (authy-docs-10), and a user describes the phone number as acting as a username alongside an Authy password (authy-comm-6). That contradicts the 'no vendor account required' half of the story. Missing for 10: account-free use without phone-number registration, and hands-on corroboration of fully offline operation.
